title: MCP Warden: a policy, budget and audit gateway for AI agent tool calls
summary: Self-hosted MCP gateway (Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL) enforcing per-agent keys, policy-as-code, rate limits, budgets and human approval on agent tool calls, with a metadata-only audit log, metrics, tracing, Compose stack and threat model.

title: pkg-quarantine: a self-hosted release-cooldown and quarantine proxy for npm and PyPI
summary: Python/FastAPI + PostgreSQL registry proxy that hides package versions younger than a configurable cooldown, enforces an org-wide kill switch and time-boxed security bypasses, flags new npm install hooks and Python .pth payloads, audits every decision, and ships a lockfile checker for CI.
